title: My GCSE Engineering NEA

GCSE Engineering NEA: Interactive Toy Till

Published on August 30, 2026


Project Overview This GCSE Engineering Non-Exam Assessment (NEA) project features a fully working interactive Toy Till. It combines precision 2D laser-cut mechanical enclosure components with custom Arduino code and embedded electronics.


Main Documentation Complete Project Documentation: GCSE Engineering NEA 2025-26 - Albin Prince Ashok Arockia Doss.pdf Contains the full design folder, initial research, manufacturing logs, CAD renders, testing, and final evaluation.


Quick Links & Resources

  • Project Brief: Primary design requirements and problem statement
  • Bill of Materials: Bill of Materials.xlsx – Itemized component list, pricing, and specs
  • System Diagrams: GCSE Engineering NEA - The Toy Till - (v1).vsdx – System flowcharts and electronic block diagrams

Repository Structure

  • 2D Lasercut Files/Design/ – CAD vector files prepared for laser cutting
  • Final_Working_Code/ – Source code powering the interactive electronics



You can find all the repository at : https://github.com/ThatAerospaceandTechGuy/GCSE-Engineering-NEA
